definitions: To be born into a wealthy family.
To have a privileged background from birth.
examples: She was born with a silver spoon in her mouth, so she never had to worry about money.
He was born with a silver spoon in his mouth, yet he chose to work hard and build his own empire.
lemma: to be born with a silver spoon in your mouth
source: to be born with a silver spoon in your mouth
